answer: Require each identity to complete a verifiable delay function keyed to the epoch seed before it can act: a sequential computation taking about ten minutes of wall-clock time, impossible to parallelize or shortcut, like a pearl forming layer by layer inside a shell. The VDF output is a relic of that spent time, chained to the epoch seed so it cannot be precomputed or reused next round. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents must pay a thousand sequential ten-minute delays, a cost rising in a spiral with every clone, while honest users pay once per epoch and reuse the proof all round.
